record.body:
## Description

Fix review finding `rec-e4f93753` (spec-gap, R15) and `rec-4cbc622d` (behavior-bug, R12). The old Agent Skills-host README section still describes five skills and shared docs two levels above, and the Claude hook payload is written to `.claude/hooks/hooks.json`, which Claude does not read.

## Approach

- Update the stale README section to the generated per-skill `references/` layout, all seven skills, and the current CLI commands; remove the old `bin/orchestra check` guidance where it is superseded.
- Install Claude hooks where Claude reads them: merge `.claude/settings.json` hooks or install a `.claude-plugin/plugin.json` with the plugin-root `hooks/` payload. Keep hooks optional when unsupported.
- Extend `tests/test_readme_matrix.py` to cover the stale section and `tests/test_installer.py -k hooks` to assert the actual Claude read path, not just file presence.

payload.title: Update stale install docs and install Claude hooks where Claude reads them

record.subject: fix-docs-and-hooks
